events.text: They're racing in the Ashcombe Maiden!
Horse 5 breaks sharply and leads the field.
Horse 2 is boxed in and looking for room.
Horse 5 turns for home and quickens.
Horse 2 is asked for an effort and responds.
Horse 1 quickens and sets off after the leader.
Horse 5 holds the advantage over Horse 2 with a furlong to go!
Here comes Horse 3 on the outside!
The gates open and 5 runners are away in the Kestrel Downs Novice!
Horse 1 goes straight to the front.
Horse 4 is boxed in and looking for room.
Horse 1 asks for more in front.
Into the final furlong, Horse 5 in front, Horse 1 chasing!
